tweets.text:
We thank God Almighty for honoring us with serving the Two Holy Mosques and caring for the pilgrims to His Sacred House. We ask God to accept from the pilgrims their Hajj, rituals, and obedience. 
With the advent of the blessed Eid Al-Adha, we congratulate our people in this blessed country and our Islamic nation on this occasion, and we call on Him, Glory be to Him, to make it a holiday of goodness, peace and stability for our nation.
